rationale: PULP_VIEW_JS_DIR lets a build read the embedded web-compat preludes from another copy of the same prelude set; the default is unchanged (core/view/js), so default builds embed byte-identical preludes. pulp-test-js-preludes now compares each embedded prelude with the configured directory. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves; the change is test-harness plumbing for comparing Pulp's suites against Vellum's published preludes.
